description_en: Releases a pay-as-you-go dedicated host or an expired subscription dedicated host
description_zh: 本接口用于释放一台按量付费专有宿主机或者到期的包年包月专有宿主机
kebab_example: aliyun ecs release-dedicated-host --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-id dh-bp199lyny9b30000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReleaseDedicatedHost

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the dedicated host. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 专有宿主机所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated host
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to release an expired subscription dedicated host.

true: Releases the host.
false: Does not release the host.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否释放已到期的包年包月专有宿主机。

true：释放。
false：不释放。

默认值：false
parameters.name: terminate_subscription
